logger.doc:name: Notification Event Received
logger.message: #['Notification received: ' ++ (vars.bookingEvent.eventType default vars.bookingEvent.notifyType default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' for ' ++ (vars.bookingEvent.appointmentId as String)]

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Notification Details
db:select.db:sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, a.start_utc, a.status, p.patient_name, p.contact_email, pr.practitioner_name, pr.specialty, c.clinic_name, c.address_line1, c.city, c.time_zone FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN practitioners pr ON a.practitioner_id = pr.practitioner_id JOIN clinics c ON a.clinic_id = c.clinic_id WHERE a.appointment_id = :appointmentId

when.expression: #[upper((vars.bookingEvent.eventType default '') as String) == 'APPOINTMENT_CANCELLED' or upper((vars.bookingEvent.notifyType default '') as String) == 'CANCELLATION']
#[ isEmpty(payload) or upper((payload[0].status default '') as String) != 'CANCELLED' ]

logger.doc:name: Cancellation Email Skipped
logger.message: Cancellation email skipped: appointment not found or not CANCELLED.

set-payload.doc:name: Build Cancellation Email
set-payload.value: #[{ emailType: 'CANCELLATION_NOTICE', appointmentId: vars.bookingDetails.appointment_id, patientName: vars.bookingDetails.patient_name, contactEmail: vars.bookingDetails.contact_email, recipientEmail: vars.bookingDetails.contact_email, startLocalLong: vars.bookingDetails.start_utc as String, localDateTime: vars.bookingDetails.start_utc as String, timeZone: vars.bookingDetails.time_zone, timeZoneLabel: vars.bookingDetails.time_zone, practitionerName: vars.bookingDetails.practitioner_name, specialtyLabel: vars.bookingDetails.specialty, clinicName: vars.bookingDetails.clinic_name, clinicAddressLine1: vars.bookingDetails.address_line1, clinicCity: vars.bookingDetails.city, cancelledByClinic: false, bookingUrl: 'Please contact your clinic to book another appointment.' }]

when.expression: #[upper((vars.bookingEvent.notifyType default '') as String) == 'CONFIRMATION' or upper((vars.bookingEvent.eventType default '') as String) == 'APPOINTMENT_BOOKED' or upper((vars.bookingEvent.eventType default '') as String) == 'BOOKING_CONFIRMATION']
#[ isEmpty(payload) or upper((payload[0].status default '') as String) != 'BOOKED' ]

logger.doc:name: Booking Email Skipped
logger.message: Booking confirmation skipped: appointment not found or not BOOKED.

set-payload.doc:name: Build Confirmation Email
set-payload.value: #[{ emailType: 'BOOKING_CONFIRMATION', appointmentId: vars.bookingDetails.appointment_id, patientName: vars.bookingDetails.patient_name, contactEmail: vars.bookingDetails.contact_email, recipientEmail: vars.bookingDetails.contact_email, startLocalLong: vars.bookingDetails.start_utc as String, localDateTime: vars.bookingDetails.start_utc as String, timeZone: vars.bookingDetails.time_zone, timeZoneLabel: vars.bookingDetails.time_zone, practitionerName: vars.bookingDetails.practitioner_name, specialtyLabel: vars.bookingDetails.specialty, clinicName: vars.bookingDetails.clinic_name, clinicAddressLine1: vars.bookingDetails.address_line1, clinicCity: vars.bookingDetails.city, manageUrl: 'Please contact your clinic to cancel or reschedule.' }]

logger.doc:name: Booking Email Processed
logger.message: #['Booking confirmation email processed for ' ++ (vars.bookingDetails.appointment_id as String)]

logger.doc:name: Reminder Received
logger.message: #['Reminder event received for appointment ' ++ (vars.reminderEvent.appointmentId as String)]

db:select.doc:name: Fetch Reminder Details
db:select.db:sql: SELECT a.appointment_id, a.start_utc, a.status, a.reminder_state, p.patient_name, p.contact_email, pr.practitioner_name, pr.specialty, c.clinic_name, c.address_line1, c.city, c.time_zone FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN practitioners pr ON a.practitioner_id = pr.practitioner_id JOIN clinics c ON a.clinic_id = c.clinic_id WHERE a.appointment_id = :appointmentId

when.expression: #[ isEmpty(payload) or upper((payload[0].status default '') as String) != 'BOOKED' or upper((payload[0].reminder_state default '') as String) == 'SENT' ]

logger.message: Reminder skipped: appointment unavailable, not BOOKED, or reminder already sent.

set-payload.doc:name: Build Reminder Email
set-payload.value: #[{ emailType: 'APPOINTMENT_REMINDER', appointmentId: vars.reminderDetails.appointment_id, patientName: vars.reminderDetails.patient_name, contactEmail: vars.reminderDetails.contact_email, recipientEmail: vars.reminderDetails.contact_email, startLocalLong: vars.reminderDetails.start_utc as String, localDateTime: vars.reminderDetails.start_utc as String, timeZone: vars.reminderDetails.time_zone, timeZoneLabel: vars.reminderDetails.time_zone, practitionerName: vars.reminderDetails.practitioner_name, specialtyLabel: vars.reminderDetails.specialty, clinicName: vars.reminderDetails.clinic_name, clinicAddressLine1: vars.reminderDetails.address_line1, clinicCity: vars.reminderDetails.city, manageUrl: 'Please contact your clinic to cancel or reschedule.' }]

db:update.doc:name: Mark Reminder Sent
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE appointments SET reminder_state = 'SENT', reminder_sent_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE appointment_id = :appointmentId AND status = 'BOOKED' AND (reminder_state IS NULL OR reminder_state != 'SENT')

db:select.doc:name: Find Due Reminders
db:select.db:sql: SELECT appointment_id FROM appointments WHERE status = 'BOOKED' AND reminder_state = 'SCHEDULED' AND reminder_due_at IS NOT NULL AND reminder_due_at <= UTC_TIMESTAMP() ORDER BY reminder_due_at

logger.doc:name: Reminder Event Published
logger.message: #['Reminder event published for appointment ' ++ (vars.currentReminder.appointment_id as String)]
